newsitem.title: USA: Shelby Williams files for two mln shrs.
newsitem.headline: Shelby Williams files for two mln shrs.

text.p: Shelby Williams Industries Inc filed a registration with the Securities and Exchange Commission to sell up to two million common shares.

Of the total, 569,000 common will be sold by the company and 1,431,000 common will be sold by Manfred Steinfeld, the chairman of the executive committee of the board of directors and Fern and Manfred Steinfeld Charitable Remainder Trust.
After the offering, outstanding shares will total 9,312,863 common.

The underwriters have been granted a 30-day over-allotment option to purchase up to 300,000 additional common shares. The offering will be made through Lazard Freres & Co LLC and Interstate/Johnson Lane Corp.

Net proceeds will be used for a powder coating system, to build or buy a new wood products facility and for automated machinery, tooling systems and other equipment. The balance will be used for general corporate purposes.
Shelby Williams, based in Chicago, Ill., is a designer, manufacturer and distributor of seating products used in the hospitality and food service industries.
